[EN] Clue of Hope
[ES] Pista de esperanza
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "..."
[ES] "..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Don't you believe me?"
[ES] "¿No me crees?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "How did you know?"
[ES] "¿Cómo lo supiste?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Fraya at Allemantheia Headquarters. [Speak with {@linkcreature:72#1103#Arshadh} to enter the Allemantheia Headquarters.]
[ES] Informa a Fraya en el cuartel general de Allemantheia. [Habla con {@linkcreature:72#1103#Arshadh} para entrar al cuartel general de Allemantheia.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] City Teleportal
[ES] Teleportador de la ciudad
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This is the City Teleportal Fraya was talking about.
[ES] Este es el teleportador de la ciudad del que hablaba Fraya.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the Allemantheia City Teleportal.
[ES] Ve al teleportador de la ciudad de Allemantheia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Front of Mysterium
[ES] Frente al Mysterium
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You hear people talking about argon research.
[ES] Escuchas a la gente hablar sobre la investigación de los argones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the City Teleportal to go to the Mysterium at the Arcane Symposium.
[ES] Usa el teleportador de la ciudad para ir al Mysterium en el Simposio Arcano.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Mysterium
[ES] Mysterium
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] They're back to work. You can feel the tension.
[ES] Han vuelto al trabajo. Puedes sentir la tensión.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the City Teleportal to go to the Mysterium at the Arcane Symposium.
[ES] Usa el teleportador de la ciudad para ir al Mysterium en el Simposio Arcano.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@linkcreature:72#1111#Ryshan}.
[ES] Ve con {@linkcreature:72#1111#Ryshan}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Combine the Argon Structure fragment to the withered leaf. [Press key to open inventory and use Argon Structure Fragment.]
[ES] Combina el fragmento de estructura argón con la hoja marchita. [Presiona la tecla para abrir el inventario y usar el fragmento de estructura argón.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The two objects combined to make a new one!
[ES] ¡Los dos objetos se combinaron para crear uno nuevo!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll answer as best as I can."
[ES] "Responderé lo mejor que pueda."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the argonized leaf to Ryshan.
[ES] Entrégale la hoja argonizada a Ryshan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay. I trust you."
[ES] "Está bien. Confío en ti."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I can't. It's classified."
[ES] "No puedo. Es clasificado."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Ryshan what he wants to know about Stepstone Isle.
[ES] Pregúntale a Ryshan qué quiere saber sobre Stepstone Isle.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll pass that along."
[ES] "Se lo transmitiré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Malachai.
[ES] Habla con Malachai.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Yes, ma'am."
[ES] "Sí, señora."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Malachai's request to Fraya at Allemantheia Headquarters and tell her what happened at the Mysterium.
[ES] Llévale la petición de Malachai a Fraya en el Allemantheia Headquarters y cuéntale lo que pasó en el Mysterium.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
